title: Cozy Cottage in Hip Neighborhd- 10 mins to DWTN
description:
Sip your morning coffee on the sunny front deck or lounge on the spacious sectional sofa of this Cozy Industrial Cottage. The “Industrial” is a reference to the neighbourhood’s past & a funky metal feature wall in the living room is a nod to that history. The remaining decor is a charming mix of old & new with bedroom decor that soothes the senses. The Tree Room features restful green tones & wood elements while The Sea Room's relaxing aqua tones & seaside theme are sure to please.

This duplex cottage is ideally suited for 4 guests but an additional 2 adults or children can be accommodated on an inflatable mattress provided and/or couch.  If you have a larger party, rent both Unit B and C.  The units share a large deck for outdoor relaxation and gatherings.

There will be a lock box on site and an email prior to check in will be sent with lock box code

We live just a few blocks away and can be available if problems or issues arise.

This hip neighborhood is 6.4 miles from Bridgestone & the action-packed excitement of the downtown nightlife. An assortment of wonderful local dining options & coffee shops are available right in the immediate neighborhood.

Approx. Uber rates are: airport $26, Bridgestone Arena - $15, Tootsie's & Broadway bars -$15. Note - Uber rates vary w demand, Ride Type & these are estimates only. (Drive time to downtown is between 10 - 15 min. based on traffic)

Getting around is super easy with Uber and Lyft.  A trip downtown will run between $7 to $10 and can be even cheaper if you select the "shared option" on Lyft.  Also,  Lime and Byrd Scooters are placed through-out the neighborhood for quick jaunts or just for fun.    If you prefer to walk, The Nations has a good deal of sidewalks but they are not everywhere.  You will likely want to take a really short Lyft or Uber to the brew pubs and coffee shops, though there is a corner store less than a block away that you can walk to to pick up sodas, beer, snacks etc.  Bike rentals are also available nearby at Charlotte Avenue and 46th.
